analysis.title: Virgin Galactic Holdings (SPCE): 3Q26 First Take: First commercial spaceflight delayed
key_insights: SPCE reported 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA of $(47)mn against FactSet consensus of $(48.7)mn and GS estimate of $(53.5)mn, so the print was in line with consensus and better than GS.
The company now expects the first commercial spaceflight in early 2Q27, versus February 2027 previously. A second spaceship is expected to begin commercial spaceflight in late 2Q/early 3Q 2027.
A new launch hangar and fueling infrastructure is planned to open in 2H 2028 and is expected to raise spaceflight capacity by 20% to 150 spaceflights per year.
The first glide flight with Apeiron is expected in January 2027.
3Q26 revenue was $0.4mn. Free cash flow was $(99)mn versus $(91)mn last quarter and $(108)mn a year ago. The company reiterated 4Q26 FCF guidance of $(90)-(80)mn.
GS rates SPCE Neutral with a 12-month price target of $3.05 (1.8x CY2027E EBITDA), 14.2% above the $2.67 close on 12 Nov 2026. Market cap is $295.7mn.

market_movers.rationale: First commercial spaceflight slipped to early 2Q27 from February 2027. 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA was in line with consensus. Target is 1.8x CY2027E EBITDA.

earnings_insights: 3Q26 adjusted EBITDA reported at $(46.7)mn versus FactSet consensus est $(48.7)mn and GS est $(53.5)mn, a $6.8mn / 12.6% variance against GS.
3Q26 revenue reported at $0.4mn versus GS est $0.4mn (+6.7%), and +17.0% y/y.
3Q26 diluted EPS reported at $(0.39) versus GS est $(0.50) and $(1.09) in 3Q25. Diluted shares were 151.6mn versus GS est 127.8mn.
3Q26 operating profit reported at $(59.0)mn versus GS est $(65.5)mn. EBITDA reported at $(52.9)mn versus GS est $(58.5)mn.
3Q26 free cash flow reported at $(99)mn versus $(91)mn in 2Q26 and $(108)mn in 3Q25. Company guidance for 4Q26 FCF is $(90)-(80)mn, reiterated.

GS forecasts: 2026E revenue $5.8mn, EBITDA $(202.6)mn, EPS $(2.21). 2027E revenue $257.0mn, EBITDA $(84.1)mn, EPS $(0.89). 2028E revenue $556.0mn, EBITDA $26.4mn. Quarterly EPS est: 4Q26E $(0.48), 1Q27E $(0.33).
risk_factors: Timelines, including further delays to commercial spaceflight.
